_note: Where each walk really ends in the book. In the PDF, each walk's map page and title page come before its title in reading order, so the parser filed the next walk's map labels, opening text and photos under the previous walk's last stop. Checked page by page against book/*.pdf. 'drop_from': first block that is not part of this walk (map labels, page references); 'move_from': first block of the next walk's opening text (from here on it moves to the next walk's introduction); 'page_from': photos on this page or later belong to the next walk; 'tail_strip': map-label words glued onto the end of a real paragraph; 'intro_drop': first and last block of map labels at the start of this walk's own introduction. For Walk XII, everything from drop_from is the book's back matter (glossary, further readings, acknowledgements, back cover).
